scope: Complete otherwise unsupported cold-item PPR intensities from schedule-projected MF, aligned by training-known candidate mass; all known PPR scores retained exactly.
time_coordinate: Original naive source wall clock; UTC encoding is arithmetic/display only, no inferred timezone
dependence: Overlapping previously observed calendar periods; these are not independent untouched tests. Later cutoffs newly evaluated with this frozen model list.
candidate_policy: All positive-duration labelled programmes overlapping each target schedule; identical pool for all methods
cohort: Original template order, users with at least one eligible accepted held-out item, fixed once before method scoring; includes cold users

targets.primary: At most5 eligible unique items by summed accepted seconds descending, ID ascending ties
targets.secondary: At most5 eligible unique items by accepted canonical-airing count descending, ID ascending ties
targets.all_observed: All eligible accepted held-out IDs, separate diagnostic
targets.empty: AP=0 convention; no-target users excluded once per slice

selection.aggregate: Unweighted arithmetic mean of three slice scores; all methods must complete all3 slices
selection.replacement: Maximum exact mean dual proxy; replace engagement reference only with higher mean and >=2/3 strict wins. Keep locally best designation independent of returned private scores.
selection.refit: Persist exactly one final selected specification before full-history refit

context.channel_vocabulary: Only channels with positive clipped historical views at that cutoff
context.history: Union raw intervals per user/channel, clip to train bounds, split at4h/calendar-day boundaries; include unlabelled, ambiguous and outside-schedule viewing without assigning programme IDs
context.profile: C[u,channel,weekday,hour4]=unioned historical seconds; G=sum_u C / sum_u,total C
context.posterior: (C_u +21600*G)/(total_C_u+21600); raw-history-empty users have no native context list and use common popularity fallback
context.schedule: Same channel_segments resolution as original join, clip to target window; duplicates/same-item overlaps unioned, conflicting nonzero seconds excluded
context.candidate_feature: A[item,slot]=unique nonconflicting labelled broadcast seconds in slot / total such seconds for item; aggregate across channels/airings
context.score: dot(posterior_u,A_item); duration-weighted MEAN availability fit. Total length/repeat count is normalized away; duplicate rows never boost score. This is availability affinity, not observed future watching

recency.formula: Sum accepted_airing_seconds *2**(-(train_cutoff-last_clipped_positive_overlap_end)/(28*86400)) per user/item; threshold fragments before decay

fusion.history_fusion: Sum equal weighted reciprocal ranks from each history native top50; component absence contributes0; no per-item weight renormalization
fusion.hybrid: Weighted reciprocal ranks of PPR-v2 top50, history_fusion over its <=150 union, and channel_time top50
fusion.retrieval_union: Union PPR top50, EACH history top50, channel top50, plus ALS32 top50 for ALS hybrid, intersect common pool
fusion.missing_component: Zero contribution, fixed weights not renormalized, no popularity padding before any fusion
fusion.ties: Score descending then programme ID ascending
fusion.fallback: After native/fused ranking append distinct training-viewer-popularity candidates; ID ascending ties. Truly no-history users use same fallback everywhere

graph.X: log1p(sum accepted seconds) normalized L1 by user
graph.C: X.T@X in item-row blocks; diagonal ignored after normalization
graph.support: Distinct positive-history user co-occurrence count from binary user/item matrix
graph.lift: Sij=n_training_users*Cij/((sum_u Xui+1)*(sum_u Xuj+1)) * support_ij/(support_ij+10), support>=2, i!=j

als.preference: p_ui=1 for positive accepted-history pairs; unobserved p=0 with baseline confidence1, not a verified dislike
als.confidence: Stored positive c_ui=1+40*log1p(accepted_seconds_ui/600); library alpha=1 to avoid multiplying twice
als.repeats: Explicit filter_already_liked_items=False in library API check; scoring all known candidate factors, never exclude history
als.native_scores: Positive finite factor dot products, known train IDs only; unknown user/item => no invented factor and common fallback/context
als.save: Local wrapper pickle plus official model.npz for fitted ALS states; controlled round-trip test
als.optional_failure: Record real dependency/resource error; retain core experiments, exclude methods missing any slice from selection, never extend grid

segments.channel_only: 0 accepted programmes and positive raw context seconds
segments.no_history: 0 accepted programmes and no raw context seconds
target_subsets: seen by same user in train

bootstrap.unit: Same raw user ID resampled with identical multiplicity across overlapping slices
bootstrap.use: Post-selection descriptive winner-v2 paired aggregate; does not correct selection bias and is not evidence of Kaggle gain

resources.cache_policy: Only same-cutoff same-config feature/graph/native-list reuse; never cross-slice fitting

external_uploads: Authorized designated candidates only, after validation and local selection; account/rules/quota must be verified.

opportunity.formula: context_mean_affinity * (deduplicated nonconflicting total candidate broadcast seconds /3600)**airtime_power
opportunity.ablation: Existing exponent0 channel_time retained. Only candidate availability changes; raw training-only profile/smoothing/ID vocabulary unchanged.
opportunity.fit: No future viewing or future content attributes; schedule totals are allowed availability only. No fitting on labels.
opportunity.zero_history: No native list if no training raw context; common fallback

stopping_conditions: Exactly23 configurations on3 already frozen overlapping long-history folds; fixed equal-fold dual proxy and >=2 strict wins, all serious exports audited, one different locally selected CSV, no duplicate upload.

mixed_restart.formula: v=(1-count_share)*L1(sqrt(accepted_seconds)) +count_share*L1(count_signal); row-normalize v defensively. Original co-view graph, dangling distribution, tolerance and top100 unchanged.
mixed_restart.recency: Use already prepared per-accepted-airing 28-day recent_watches with ends bounded by cutoff, not last-item timestamp.
mixed_restart.hypothesis: v3 duration-aware PPR/fusion beats watches on seconds; watches wins count proxy. Convex restart blends and two fixed RRF weights may improve their frozen compromise. Recency may downweight stale frequent programmes in the fixed heavy-user example.
mixed_restart.external_feedback_disclosure: v3 private .36630 was first observed and exact submitted bytes downloaded after round01 freeze. It confirms the target remains unmet; no returned score is used to fit or select this round.

exposure_rate.canonical_airing: Same-channel duplicate/overlap union, conflicting labelled seconds excluded. Count one canonical airing if its nonconflicting clipped labelled seconds >=120. Adjoining airings distinct.
exposure_rate.source: Historical/future schedule only: ID, channel, start and duration, no view behavior or future content attributes. Historical baseline uses only pre-cutoff schedule. Target exposure is known availability, not fitted preference.
exposure_rate.retrieval: Score all base-model known candidates, apply fixed availability gain, then native top50. Unknown CF items get no factor/score; shared fallback remains.
exposure_rate.hypothesis: Raw train favourite ranks ignore changing broadcast opportunity. Reused v3 watch-target misses have lower median future/historical airing-rate change than hits; apply bounded availability-rate reranking to independently evaluated PPR seeds.
exposure_rate.external_feedback: Round02 locally selected candidate returned private .35452, below already verified v3 .36630. Rate features and error diagnosis were prepared separately; parameter choices and local objective do not optimize returned scores.

count_nmf.matrix: CSR users x training items; q_ui=accepted_airing_count_ui / sum_j accepted_airing_count_uj
count_nmf.objective: Generalized KL(q||WH) + .5*1e-6*n_items*||W||F^2 + .5*1e-6*n_users*||H||F^2, W,H>=0. This reconstructs nonnegative relative implicit count intensity, not fabricated explicit ratings.
count_nmf.unobserved: Zero recorded intensity in the observed training log; no verified dislike. Equal observation/exposure is an approximation and zeros influence the KL objective.
count_nmf.regularization: Low rank16/32, fixed small scaled L2 coefficient, iteration cap100 and training-only tolerance1e-4; no validation-based early stopping
count_nmf.repeats: Allowed, no filtering of observed IDs
count_nmf.native: Known training item factor products, finite positive scores only; no factors invented for unknown users/items
count_nmf.hybrids: RRF parents = locally best availability-adjusted PPR and history_watches; MF weights .10/.25, fixed before metrics; no padding or per-candidate renormalization
count_nmf.hypothesis: Binary preference ALS poorly recovers repeats. Direct relative count-intensity factorization may preserve preference strength and complement PPR/history.
count_nmf.external_feedback: Round02 private .35452 and round03 .35327, both below existing v3 .36630; all retained. The new objective is motivated by local ALS repeat/ranking failures and uses the same frozen dual-proxy selection, not returned scores.

external_feedback_disclosure: Known real private results: v3 .36630, round02 .35452,03 .35327,04 .37018,07 .36363. Round05/06 identical bytes were not submitted. Round07 remains the local reference despite worse private feedback. Globally unseen held-out positions and missing-factor policy motivate this candidate-support hypothesis; private scores do not select alphas/shrinkage or parent. User-authorized27-candidate verification portfolio is frozen and uploading; no batch result has been used for this cold-completion hypothesis or numeric settings.

engagement.hypothesis: Finite five-signal engagement ablation: capped10/30min, fraction, distinct active days, recent10min cap. Each auxiliary history, PPR and the same fixed availability/MF wrappers; no joint weight tuning.
engagement.acceptance: Original120s canonical-airing rule unchanged; all seconds/counts exactly match old exports; no future viewing
engagement.PPR: Same co-view transition, L1 engagement restart, alpha=.1; no new graph fitting or per-user hyperparameters

inductive_mf.hypothesis: Finite inductive-MF support ablation: historical schedule regression to fixed MF16 item factors, cold factor shrinkage, unchanged known factors and two already evaluated fixed PPR parents.
inductive_mf.features: Canonical broadcast hours per day in training-channel x weekday x4h slots; historical map fits before cutoff, target map uses allowed availability only
inductive_mf.objective: min_B ||X_history B - V_MF16||_F^2 + alpha ||B||_F^2, no intercept. For unknown programme IDs, V_new=gamma*max(0,X_target B); known factors retained exactly. Score=U_user dot V_item.
inductive_mf.interpretation: Auxiliary schedule-conditioned factor extension of implicit MF; no future preference fitting or independent third-family claim.

cold_completion.formula: For known items score=base_PPR. For globally unseen items score=projected_MF * sum_known(base_PPR)/sum_known(projected_MF). Zero denominator contributes no completion. Full common pool, before top50/fallback.
cold_completion.hyperparameters: No new numeric tuning; inherit the4 frozen ridge/shrinkage states and2 previously evaluated PPR parents.
